entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane of five shards, whose style guide and fusion of shards are the subject of this column.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: Figure of Alara who delivered a stirring war-speech near a chunk of fallen marble.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: Figure of Alara who developed the formula for etherium in a rune-scratched tower.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: Figure of Alara who first saw blood on the edge of a blade in a dusty arena.

entities.name: Kresh the Bloodbraided
entities.description: Impulsive Jund figure who inspired the name Bloodbraid Elf.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara, home of crossbow-snipers; its status quo is broken up by ethercaste.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara whose people embrace etherium and technology.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Rotting shard of Alara ruled by undead.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard of Alara home to wurms, goblins and viashino.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Jungle shard of Alara home to elves, leonin and behemoths.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: Forest whose out-of-control growth is due largely to the magic of the Mirari.

entities.name: Krosan Cloudscraper
entities.description: Massive beast product of the Krosan Forest, probably magically augmented in size.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Magical source credited with the wild growth of the Krosan Forest.

events.summary: Naya elves journey through the rotting land of Grixis, and Grixis undead assault a Bant stronghold, as examples of Alara Reborn's fusion of shards.
events.quote: Zealous Persecution shows Grixis undead assaulting a Bant stronghold.

events.summary: A Jund wurm makes itself at home in Naya, eating elves and leonin in place of goblins and viashino.
events.quote: A Jund wurm makes itself at home in the lush, green jungles and stone ruins of Naya.

relations.quote: is the product of the Krosan Forest

relations.note: its magic causes the forest's out-of-control growth
relations.quote: a forest whose out-of-control growth is due largely to the magic of the Mirari
